seo.title: Software that cuts costs and automates operations
seo.description: We build ordering, booking and operations software for shops, restaurants, clinics, schools and startups. Talk to the engineers who build it.

hero.eyebrow: Software and automation for growing businesses

headline.before: We help businesses cut costs and
headline.after: their operations, so they move faster.

hero.intro: Still doing by hand what software could do for you? We build the systems that take orders, book appointments and keep records straight, for shops, restaurants, clinics, schools and more.
hero.note: We reply to every message within one business day.

automation.label: Example automation
automation.footnote: An example of the systems we build. Every step above is usually done by hand.

scenarios.title: Restaurant
handled: Order #1042 sent to the kitchen screen
Mozzarella running low, reorder drafted
Receipt emailed to the customer

scenarios.title: Store
handled: Order #2210 sent to the warehouse pick list
Stock updated on every sales channel
Shipping label created and emailed

scenarios.title: Tours
handled: Saturday slot blocked as soon as the deposit lands
Guide told the group size and pickup point
Confirmation and reminder sent to the guest

scenarios.title: Clinic
handled: Slot reserved and the doctor's day updated
Patient history ready before the visit
Reminder scheduled for the day before

scenarios.title: Diagnostics
handled: Sample #5521 tracked from collection to lab
Report generated the moment the result is signed off
Patient gets a secure link to download it

scenarios.title: School
handled: Student record created from the admission form
Parents told the same morning when a child is absent
Fee receipt issued and the ledger balanced

scenarios.title: Pet care
handled: Grooming slot confirmed and added to the groomer's day
Shop order packed from live stock
Owner reminded when a vaccine is due

scenarios.title: Retail
handled: Every sale deducts stock across all outlets
Purchase order drafted when items run low
Daily sales report sent to the owner

industries.name: Ecommerce stores
industries.pain: Losing sales because your store is slow or hard to manage?
industries.seoDescription: Custom storefronts, checkout, inventory and multi vendor marketplaces for online stores that have outgrown their template.
industries.intro: A fast storefront and an admin your team can run without a developer.

industries.name: Food and restaurants
industries.pain: Giving delivery apps a big cut of every order?
industries.seoDescription: Direct online ordering, table reservations and kitchen display systems that keep the margin that delivery apps take.
industries.intro: Take orders and bookings directly, and send them straight to the kitchen.

industries.name: Travel and tours
industries.pain: Still confirming bookings over WhatsApp and spreadsheets?
industries.seoDescription: Booking engines with live availability, deposits and online payments for tour operators and travel businesses.
industries.intro: Let guests book and pay online while your calendar stays correct.

industries.name: Clinics and doctors
industries.pain: Patients waiting, files missing, prescriptions hard to read?
industries.seoDescription: Appointment booking, patient records and digital prescriptions for clinics and doctors who want less paperwork.
industries.intro: Shorter waiting rooms and records that are always where you need them.

industries.name: Diagnostic centers
industries.pain: Reports delayed because results still live on paper?
build: Lab reports sent to patients online
industries.seoTitle: Diagnostic Center and Lab Report Software
industries.seoDescription: Test booking, sample tracking and online report delivery for diagnostic centers moving off paper.
industries.intro: From sample to report, tracked and delivered to the patient online.

industries.name: Schools
industries.pain: Fees, attendance and results spread across registers and Excel?
industries.seoDescription: Admissions, attendance, fees and report cards in one system for schools replacing registers and spreadsheets.
industries.intro: One place for students, classes, fees and results.

industries.name: Pet businesses
industries.pain: Running the shop and the grooming bookings in two different places?
industries.seoTitle: Pet Shop and Grooming Booking Software
industries.seoDescription: An online pet shop, grooming bookings and pet profiles with reminders, managed from one admin.
industries.intro: Sell products and book care from the same system.

industries.name: FMCG and retail
industries.pain: Not sure what stock you have until someone counts it?
build: ERP for stock, purchasing and accounts
industries.seoTitle: ERP and POS Software for Retail and FMCG
industries.seoDescription: Stock, purchasing, POS and distributor ordering for FMCG and retail businesses that need to see inventory live.
industries.intro: Know what you have, what you sold and what to reorder.

startup.pain: Launching something new and need a first version real users can pay for?
build: Payments and accounts from day one
